procedures.procedure: Balance Sheet Equilibrium: Total Assets == Total Liabilities + Total Stockholders' Equity
Current Assets Footing: Total Current Assets == Cash + AR + Inventory + Prepaid Expenses
Total Assets Footing: Total Assets == Total Current Assets + Total Non-Current Assets
Current Liabilities Footing: Total Current Liabilities == AP + Short-Term Debt + Current LT Debt + Accrued Expenses
Total Liabilities Footing: Total Liabilities == Total Current Liabilities + Total Non-Current Liabilities
Stockholders' Equity Footing: Equity == Common Stock + APIC + Retained Earnings + AOCI - Treasury Stock
Gross Profit Calculation: Gross Profit == Revenue - Cost of Goods Sold
Operating Income Calculation: Operating Income == Gross Profit - Operating Expenses
Net Income Calculation: Net Income == Operating Income + Non-Operating Income - Interest Expense - Income Tax Expense
Cash Flow Net Change: Net Change in Cash == Operating CF + Investing CF + Financing CF
Cash Flow Ending Cash: Ending Cash == Beginning Cash + Net Change in Cash

procedures.procedure: Retained Earnings Roll-Forward: Ending RE == Beginning RE + Current Net Income - Dividends Declared
Comparative Assets: Current Report PY Total Assets == Audited Prior-Year Total Assets
Comparative Cash: Current Report PY Cash == Audited Prior-Year Cash
Comparative Retained Earnings: Current Report PY Retained Earnings == Audited Prior-Year Retained Earnings
Comparative Revenue: Current Report PY Revenue == Audited Prior-Year Revenue
Comparative Net Income: Current Report PY Net Income == Audited Prior-Year Net Income
AR Aging Schedule Footing: Gross AR (Footnote) == Sum of Aging Buckets
Net AR Footnote Calculation: Net AR (Footnote) == Gross AR - Allowance for Credit Losses
AR Footnote to Balance Sheet: Note Net AR == Balance Sheet Net Accounts Receivable
PP&E Footnote Net Book Value: Ending Net PP&E == Ending Gross PP&E - Ending Accumulated Depreciation
PP&E Footnote to Balance Sheet: Note Net PP&E == Balance Sheet Net Property, Plant & Equipment
Debt Maturity Schedule Sum: Total Future Debt Maturities == Sum of Scheduled Debt
Short-Term Debt Maturity Match: Year 1 Debt Maturity == Balance Sheet Current Portion of LT Debt
Long-Term Debt Maturity Match: Sum of Years 2-Thereafter Maturities == Balance Sheet Long-Term Debt
